flags: Long-stay test 5 (home community / sells homes) fails: the operator's page is titled '55+ RV & Manufactured Homes' and lists 'Explore Our Featured Homes' at $34,900 and $14,900 with 'View All Homes'; Campspot's description says it 'caters both to year-round residents and snow birds'. Nights are genuinely sold (68 RV sites at $74-84 for one night in November and April), but December-March nights are not offered online at all (1, 7 and 31-night queries from 2027-01-12, and 2026-12-01, returned nothing). Fort Myers family-proximity exception applies to price only.
Phone: the operator page gives (239) 205-1491 and Campspot (239) 694-5534; the entry has 239-205-1488.
Name: Campspot calls it 'Orange Grove RV Resort - Ft. Myers, FL'; the operator site 'Orange Grove'.
